question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Transportation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given passage the correct option to be filled in the blank is **Transportation.**
 
• Transportation: The transfer of goods or persons between locations.
 
 
• Example: *A bicycle is a cheap means of transportation.*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore the correct option is Transportation.

​The complete sentence is: The improvement of roads in the 1700s and 1800s made the transportation of goods and people much easier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Traffic** refers to the number of vehicles travelling along a road or the number of vehicles travelling by plane, rail, or ship.
 
• **Delivery** refers to the action of delivering items, correspondence, packages, etc. to people's homes or places of employment.
 
• **Shipment** refers to sending several items at once to a location or the act of sending them.
